title: Catching Fire
author: Suzanne Collins
summary: After surviving the Games, Katniss and Peeta return home as celebrities, but the Capitol sees their act of defiance as a threat. Unrest spreads through the districts, and a new Games awaits.
readIf: you want the second book of a trilogy that raises the stakes and sharpens the politics.
skipIf: you haven't read the first book; it won't make sense alone.

pairings.reason: Another young heroine pulled into a deadly power struggle and a world of rebellion.
A fantasy equivalent about oppression, trials and rebellion, with more romance.
Another dystopian series with a teen heroine and a society that sorts people.
